fusions.name: Trample Surge
fusions.desc: Your swarm surges forward in a cone 3.5 tiles long and deals 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Carried on the Swarm
fusions.desc: Your swarm carries you up to 6 tiles to one enemy, where you strike for 14 damage and leave it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Borne Along
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds, with +6% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Second Wind Beneath
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
